material_decisions: Define business boundary and reject unrelated scope. Define user journeys and paid-service discovery. Trace acceptance and phased release to outcomes. Trigger integration/migration and reuse investigation. Avoid charging replacement work where reuse is verified. Rank options without promising incompatible scope/date/budget. Put external milestones and approvals in dependency schedule. Detect commercial infeasibility and phase scope; no currency conversion by assumption. Exclude prohibited vendors and include procurement lead time. Select maintainable alternatives and include handover/support work.

Define per-surface scope; web and mobile are not exclusive. Activate domain branches without forcing compatible needs into one radio option. Identify platform-specific build/release/QA work. Test layout/device coverage; other device needs specialist review. Evaluate PWA adequacy against capability and distribution constraints. Choose synchronization/encryption design and avoid promising conflict-free offline behavior. Screen native/cross-platform/PWA constraints; verify current platform support later. Make device scope testable; unresolved vendor protocols require specialist review. Prevent duplicate foundation estimates and identify cross-surface consistency.

Choose account/recovery and public/private boundaries. Define server authorization matrix and admin complexity. Trigger tenancy/invitations/isolation only when actual scope requires it. Add identity integration/recovery work; privileged admin MFA is separately required. Define ownership, audit, retention and secure support scope.

Compare standard CMS against custom editorial requirements. Determine database search versus dedicated search and indexing effort. Price translation and rendering separately; do not derive market from language. Include public rendering, redirect mapping and consent work. Discover lead integrations and support responsibilities. Branch fulfillment/entitlements/subscription scope. Define catalog size and stock transaction integrity. Compare standard commerce feature fit and custom commercial rules. Define payment/security/integration discovery; no automatic legal applicability verdict. Identify fulfillment, accounting and exception work. Specify transactional booking consistency and calendar complexity. Cover deposits, waitlists, recurrence and state transitions. Define marketplace trust and matching scope. Require specialist review for unresolved settlement obligations; do not assume payment-service permission. Map portal feature families to quantified follow-ups. Define work units and tenant boundaries; proficiency remains separate from package tier. Open exact file/realtime/moderation workloads. Specify storage, processing, notification and moderation costs. Activate AI task/safety/inference cost review. Separate deterministic authority from narrative AI; include evaluation and recurring usage.
An undocumented or unavailable integration remains a dependency/manual-review item. Include profiling, rehearsal, cutover and rollback effort; avoid hidden migration work.

Describe stored identities and growth; never infer server capacity directly. Derive behavioral workload only with explicit operation frequency. Identify peak interaction load independently from account count. Compare storage, cache, worker and query designs under explicit workload assumptions. Design transaction boundaries and realtime infrastructure against actual operations. Estimate storage, backup and migration work separately from traffic. Capacity validation includes burst/ramp, not just monthly averages. Select latency test conditions and deployment alternatives without assuming hosting geography.

Quality targets constrain architecture and recurring operations; require later load evidence. Choose backup/replication/recovery alternatives and test scope. Place transactional boundaries and concurrency/idempotency work. Avoid silent failure and define degraded-mode scope. Include instrumentation and avoid logging answers/secrets by default. Estimate service staffing and ongoing cost separately from build. Include accessibility design, manual evaluation and remediation effort. Trigger minimization, security and qualified specialist discovery; no automated compliance verdict. Eliminate incompatible deployment and vendor options. Define storage lifecycle and deletion/backup costs. Gate affected activity on qualified review; retain provisional alternatives.

Specify visual scope instead of pricing adjectives. Estimate design asset work and licensing explicitly. Separate functional feedback from optional visual scope and avoid essential motion. Expose content/localization critical path and price work once.

Use role categories and integer distinct people; documentation roster is not hiring roster. Resource-level schedule; no person exceeds their available hours. Add external review lead times and acceptance gates. Identify critical external dependencies and realistic phased options. Separate recurring maintenance from build and handover.
Freeze an input revision for reproducible outputs or return to scoped clarification.
